description: This Kotlin source file defines the WidgetUpdateHelper object, which provides functionality to update all app widgets, including retrieving widget IDs and calling the widget provider's update method.

classes.name: WidgetUpdateHelper
classes.description: A singleton object providing static methods to update all widgets of the application.

methods.name: updateAllWidgets
methods.description: Retrieves all widget IDs using AppWidgetManager and updates each widget by calling the provider's update method. Handles exceptions and logs the update process.
